title: The Question After the Answer
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。架空の人物、事例、製品を使った文章であり、実在の制度・調査結果・個別の医療栄養助言ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A mathematics teacher gives her class a problem that can be solved by following a procedure they have recently practiced.
sentences.ja: 数学教師は最近練習した手順で解ける問題をクラスに出す。

sentences.en: Most students obtain the correct answer, and several complete the calculation more quickly than they did during the previous lesson.
sentences.ja: 大半は正解を得て数人は前授業より速く計算を終える。

sentences.en: Instead of immediately introducing a more difficult calculation, the teacher asks the students to explain what would have to change for their usual procedure to become inappropriate.
sentences.ja: すぐ難しい計算を導入せず、通常の手順が不適切になるには何が変わる必要があるか説明させる。

sentences.en: The question requires them to examine the conditions under which their answer was produced.
sentences.ja: 問いは答えが生成された条件を調べることを求める。

sentences.en: Some students initially find the request confusing because they have become accustomed to treating the correct result as the end of a task.
sentences.ja: 正解を課題の終わりと扱うのに慣れているため当初要求を分かりにくいと感じる生徒もいる。

sentences.en: They know which steps to perform but have rarely been asked to identify the reasons why those steps are appropriate.
sentences.ja: どの段階を実行するかは知るが適切である理由を特定するようめったに求められたことがない。

sentences.en: The teacher provides a related problem in which an important condition has been altered.
sentences.ja: 重要条件が変更された関連問題を教師が提供する。

sentences.en: Students compare the two cases and identify which parts of their original procedure remain useful and which parts need revision.
sentences.ja: 二事例を比較し元手順のどの部分が有用なままかどの部分に修正が必要か特定する。

sentences.en: The discussion reveals several different kinds of understanding.
sentences.ja: 議論は複数の異なる種類の理解を明らかにする。

sentences.en: One student explains why the original method applies only to a particular category of problems, while another demonstrates a useful way to recognize that category.
sentences.ja: 一人は元の方法が特定分類の問題にのみ適用される理由を説明し、別の一人は分類の認識方法を示す。

sentences.en: A third proposes a different approach and considers whether it would lead to a comparable result under the original conditions.
sentences.ja: 三人目は別方法を提案し元の条件で同等の結果につながるか考える。

sentences.en: These explanations provide information that would be difficult to obtain from a list of correct answers alone.
sentences.ja: 説明は正解一覧だけでは得にくい情報を提供する。

sentences.en: The teacher nevertheless continues to provide opportunities for students to practice calculations until familiar procedures become easier to perform.
sentences.ja: それでも教師は慣れた手順をより容易に行えるようになるまで計算練習機会を提供し続ける。

sentences.en: She does not treat speed and conceptual understanding as goals that must always compete with one another.
sentences.ja: 速さと概念理解を常に競合すべき目標とは扱わない。

sentences.en: The fictional lesson illustrates a distinction between practicing a procedure and learning to recognize when it is useful.
sentences.ja: 架空授業は手順練習とそれが有用な場面の認識を学ぶことの区別を示す。

sentences.en: It does not establish the effectiveness of any particular instructional method in an actual classroom.
sentences.ja: 実教室で特定教授法の有効性を実証するものではない。

sentences.en: An answer can demonstrate an achievement without revealing every ability that contributed to it.
sentences.ja: 答えは成果を示してもそれに貢献した全能力を明らかにしないことがある。

sentences.en: A useful follow-up question encourages learners to examine the relationship between their procedures and the problems they are trying to solve.
sentences.ja: 有用な追加質問は手順と解こうとする問題の関係を吟味するよう学習者を促す。

sentences.en: Such reflection helps distinguish merely repeating a method from understanding the circumstances under which that method is appropriate.
sentences.ja: その熟考は単に方法を反復することと方法が適切な状況の理解を区別する助けになる。

sentences.en: The correct answer is therefore not always the last opportunity for learning.
sentences.ja: したがって正解は必ずしも学習の最後の機会ではない。

vocabulary.definition: study of numbers and related concepts
process of finding a numerical result

options: Solve every new problem without practice.
Obtain the correct answer to the familiar problem.

questions.prompt: What does the teacher's next question test?
options: Understanding when the usual procedure applies.
Memory of the date of the lesson.
A list of all future answers.
The same problem with no changes.
A related problem with a changed condition.
They usually treat obtaining a correct answer as the end of the task.
They have never learned any calculation method.
They already know all the conditions.
questions.explanation_ja: 正解で終わりという習慣。

options: Why all problems have identical solutions.
Why every answer should be memorized.
Why the method applies only to a particular category.

questions.prompt: What do explanations reveal beyond scores?
options: The identical ability of every student.
A guarantee of success on future exams.

questions.prompt: What does the teacher continue to offer?
options: A guarantee of perfect examination scores.
Speed and conceptual understanding can both be worthwhile.
Fast calculation is the sole goal.
questions.explanation_ja: 速さと理解は両立し得る。

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the argument?
options: A correct result proves all relevant understanding.
Practice and understanding must always compete.
Teachers should avoid asking follow-up questions.
Solving a problem includes learning why and when a procedure is applicable.
questions.explanation_ja: 適用条件と理由の理解。

grammar.focus: for their usual procedure to become inappropriate

paraphrases.source: Instead of immediately introducing a more difficult calculation, the teacher asks the students to explain what would have to change for their usual procedure to become inappropriate.
paraphrases.rewrite: She asks what change would make their normal method unsuitable.

paraphrases.source: Some students initially find the request confusing because they have become accustomed to treating the correct result as the end of a task.
paraphrases.rewrite: They are used to stopping once they get a correct result.

paraphrases.source: One student explains why the original method applies only to a particular category of problems, while another demonstrates a useful way to recognize that category.
paraphrases.rewrite: One student explains the method's scope; another shows how to recognize relevant problems.

paraphrases.source: Such reflection helps distinguish merely repeating a method from understanding the circumstances under which that method is appropriate.
paraphrases.rewrite: Thinking carefully separates mechanical repetition from awareness of when a method works.

discourse.role_ja: 難問ではなく条件の問い。
理解だけでなく反復も継続。

cloze.explanation_ja: 正解で終えることに慣れている。
